resources.string: Keep the sensor still under stable illumination, without the window or filter. Measure for 30 seconds. Configure suitable offsets beforehand.
Fit the window or filter without moving the sensor or light source. Wait for stable illumination, then start the second 30-second measurement.
Review the proposed channel factors. Unusable channels and the common multiplier stay unchanged.
Measurement unavailable or conditions changed. Check light stability, connection and settings, then restart without the window.
